title: Zigud
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The well-known proverb refers to him: “Tuvia sinned, and Zigud is flogged,” as in Pesachim 113b and Makkot 11a. He came before Rav Papa and testified alone that Tuvia had sinned, and Rav Papa flogged Zigud.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Pesachim 113b explicitly names Rav Papa: Zigud testifies alone about Tuvia, and Rav Papa punishes Zigud. Makkot 11a uses the same proverb. The spelling of the names and the distinction between the sinner and the punished witness are retained; no additional legal ruling is imported into the notice.
